description: ONE-SHOT: resolve a verified-fit kit and return a hosted PayPal approve URL (USD). Prefer for clear buy intent. Pass optional shipToCountry for soft shipping estimate. Single verified match → checkout immediately. Multiple → choices. Wait ~60s then poll getOrderStatus every 60s.

deviceQuery.description: Device model text, e.g. Roborock S7 or S7+

need.description: What they want, e.g. 3-month kit, bulk pack, filter

productId.description: Product id or slug if already known

shipToCountry.description: ISO country for soft shipping estimate

name: quickCheckout
